% 1. Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _)}.
n_cols(N) :- N = #count{C : input(_, C, _)}.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

% Cell set
output_cell(R, C) :- row(R), col(C).

% Find the three (at most) distinct non-8 colors that appear in the three special columns.
firstColor(F) :- input(R,C,F), C != 0, C != 8, (C \ 5) = 1, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4.
secondColor(S) :- input(R,C,S), S != 0, S != 8, (C \ 5) = 3, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4.
thirdColor(T) :- input(R,C,T), T != 0, T != 8, (C \ 5) = 5, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4.

% Exactly one distinct color for each of the three groups (if present)
#count{R,C : input(R,C,F), (C \ 5) = 1, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4} = 1.
#count{R,C : input(R,C,S), (C \ 5) = 3, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4} = 1.
#count{R,C : input(R,C,T), (C \ 5) = 5, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4} = 1.

% Output rules (priorities matter)
output(R,C,8) :- C - (C \ 5) * 5 = 4, output_cell(R,C).

output(R,C,X) :- C \ 5 = 1, firstColor(F), X = F, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4, output_cell(R,C).

output(R,C,X) :- C \ 5 = 3, secondColor(S), X = S, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4, output_cell(R,C).

output(R,C,X) :- C \ 5 = 5, thirdColor(T), X = T, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4, output_cell(R,C).

output(R,C,0) :- output_cell(R,C), not (C \ 5 = 1), not (C \ 5 = 3), not (C \ 5 = 5), C - (C \ 5) * 5 != 4.

% Exactly one color per output cell
1 { output(R,C,X) : output(R,C,X) } 1 :- output_cell(R,C).

% Show only the output predicate
#show output/3.

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Grid dimensions
n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _)}.
n_cols(M) :- M = #count{C : input(_, C, _)}.
row(0..N-1) :- n_rows(N).
col(0..M-1) :- n_cols(M).

output_cell(R,C) :- row(R), col(C).

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Column classification (5‑column blocks, vertical 8‑stripe at remainder 4)
vertical(C)      :- C \ 5 = 4.
nonvertical(C)   :- C \ 5 = 0, C \ 5 = 1, C \ 5 = 2, C \ 5 = 3.

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% The last row supplies the colour for each non‑vertical column
maxRow(Rmax) :- row(Rmax), not row(Rmax+1).

canonical_color(C,Color) :- maxRow(Rmax), input(Rmax, C, Color), nonvertical(C).

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Output for the vertical 8‑stripe cells
output(R,C,8) :- vertical(C), input(R,C,8).

% Output for all other cells – copy the colour that appears in the last row
output(R,C,Color) :- nonvertical(C), canonical_color(C,Color), output_cell(R,C).

#show output/3.

n_rows(N) :- N = #count{R : input(R, _, _)}.
n_cols(N) :- N = #count{C : input(_, C, _)}.

% secondColor(S) appears in the middle block (columns where floor(C/5)=3, i.e. columns 15‑18)
secondColor(S) :- input(R,C,S), S != 0, S != 8, (C \ 5) = 3, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4.
% thirdColor(T) appears in the next block (columns where floor(C/5)=5, i.e. columns 25‑28)

thirdColor(T) :- input(R,C,T), T != 0, T != 8, (C \ 5) = 5, (C - (C \ 5) * 5) != 4.

% ------------------------------------------------------------
% Output cell rules (ordered so that more specific rules win)
